description:
Beom Tae-Hyeok buys Moon Yi-Soo for 100 million won while she is working as a server at a loan-shark club to pay off her boyfriend's debt. 

"You’ll have to prove you’re worth 100 million won," he says. 

"How?" 

"With your body." 

When Yi-Soo asks if she can just work to pay it back, Tae-Hyeok sneers coldly. 

"I don't need the money. I need a maid to play with."

Eventually, Yi-Soo signs the maid contract, and from that night on, her body and heart begin to surrender to Tae-Hyeok in their dizzying encounters.
